instruction: Candid street photograph, full shot. Outdoors in front of a dark wooden doorway, the blonde woman in a brown cap and black vest (R1) on the left walks forward holding a yellow drink, looking at the red-haired woman in a blue knit vest and brown pleated skirt (R2) on the right, who walks beside her. They walk side-by-side out of the building under natural daylight.
